s1.syndrome_frame: Abdominal mass with variable growth pattern in a patient with history of plasma cell myeloma
salient_findings: 35 mm lesion in the right hepatic lobe with SUVmax of 6.1 on PET/CT
17 mm lesion in segment VI with moderately increased T2 signal and restricted diffusion on MRI
Lesion size decreased to 10 mm then enlarged to 57 × 46 mm on serial imaging
key_facts: Patient has IgG kappa plasma cell myeloma
Patient has undergone multiple chemotherapy regimens
Patient has undergone two autologous stem-cell transplants
Patient has undergone thalidomide maintenance and focal bone radiotherapy
Patient is asymptomatic with stable vital signs
No hepatosplenomegaly on examination
Liver function tests are within normal limits
PET/CT showed a 35 mm lesion in the right hepatic lobe with SUVmax of 6.1
MRI showed a 17 mm lesion in segment VI with moderately increased T2 signal and restricted diffusion
Lesion size decreased to 10 mm then enlarged to 57 × 46 mm on serial imaging
Percutaneous liver biopsy was planned to establish a definitive diagnosis

rejected.why: While possible, this diagnosis is less likely given the patient's known history of plasma cell myeloma and the lesion's characteristics, which do not specifically suggest a discrete plasmacytoma.

rejected.why: The patient's liver function tests are within normal limits, and there is no mention of cirrhosis or other risk factors for hepatocellular carcinoma, making this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Metastatic disease
rejected.why: There is no mention of a primary malignancy other than plasma cell myeloma, and the lesion's characteristics do not specifically suggest metastasis from another cancer.

rejected.why: This diagnosis is less likely given the patient's history and the lesion's characteristics, which do not specifically suggest lymphoma, and there is no mention of other symptoms or findings typical of lymphoma.
